decision: Use ODATA's own store-locator coordinate for 'ODATA DC SP03' as the campus locator of the SP03 data centre. The Google Maps address place for Alameda Araguacema, 187 that ODATA's former SP03 facility page linked lies 46.3 m south-west on the same building and corroborates the point; it is not used as the locator.

source.extraction: The page's store-locator element carries an HTML-escaped data-locations JSON array of 12 ODATA facilities. Entry id 8617 (title 'ODATA DC SP03', category Brazil, address 'Alameda Araguacema, 187 - Tamboré, Barueri - SP, 06460-070, Brasil') carries the coordinates string '-23.501657,-46.8248305', parsed with Python json after html.unescape and split on the comma (latitude first). The same entry with the same literal is present in the Spanish locations page captured on 22 October 2026 (local_data/country-research-mx-p1/odata-es-localidades.html, published evidence c00f9a5e-864d-5311-b6fa-a7a8d92f1bed) and again on 26 October 2026 (local odata-es-localidades.html). No geocoder or map search was used.

imagery_check.observation: The locator falls on the light-roofed annex along the east side of a grey-roofed industrial building of roughly 55-65 m by 100 m (annex included) (about 6,000-6,600 m2 by eye, close to the 6,220 m2 built area on ODATA's former SP03 page) carrying several rows of rooftop plant units, with a light-roofed annex along its east side and a plant enclosure at its south end; the operator-linked address place falls on the south-western part of the same building. Consistent with a mid-sized data-centre building in the Tamboré industrial district; the building is not labelled in the imagery and this is visual plausibility only, not a measured accuracy.
